title: Midday Sunwatch
text:
🌤️ Midday Sunwatch — October 09, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Moderate (C1.1)
🔥 Latest solar flare: M1.3 (Peaked October 09, 2026 at 14:09 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 376 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 2.00)
🚨 NOAA Alert: Geomagnetic K-index of 4

Sunny just spit out an M-Class flare! 🔥💣🚀📡

A bright active region stands out in today’s solar EUV images, while the coronagraph shows no clearly visible large outward eruption.

Images: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 195, 284, 171, 304, 131, 094 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
